Media Converter
10/100Base-TX to 100Base-FX
10/100/1000Base-T to 1000Base-X
10/100/1G/2.5G/5G/10GBase-T to 10GBase-X
User Manual
Brief introduction
Media converter transmits IP over fiber, applied in many places where need long distance transmission. Enlarge the TP network range by MM or SM fiber. Low consumption and high resistance to electromagnetic interference of the optical fiber make the transmitting distance spread from 100m to several decades KM or hundred KM, improve the communication quality as well. And make the IP camera, server, repeaters, switch, terminal PC connect easily. The user manual introduces Media Converter installation, function, use and maintenance. Please read the user manual carefully before installation
Packing list
Please check the following items in the package before installing the media converter.
Media Converter    		1pc
AC/DC Power Adaptor 	1pc
User Manual			1copy
Please contact us or local agent immediately for any loss or damage to the above items.
Installation
1. RJ-45 Interface
The transmission media adopts CAT5e or CAT6 twisted-pair with maximum length up to 100meters (330feets).
Fiber Interface
(1).Fast Ethernet and Gigabit Ethernet media converter: SC/ST/FC/LC fiber interface is of duplex mode type, including two interfaces, namely TX and RX. When the two sets of optical transceiver are interfaced or connected to switch with fiber interface, the fiber is in cross connection, namely "TX-RX", "RX-TX" (direct butting for single optical fiber transceiver module).
(2). 10G media converter: LC fiber interface is of duplex mode type, including two interfaces, namely TX and RX. When the two sets of optical transceiver are interfaced or connected to switch with fiber interface, the fiber is in cross connection, namely "TX-RX", "RX-TX" (direct butting for single optical fiber transceiver module)
Power Supply Interface
The AC/DC power adaptor is connected to DC-input jack of media converter.
4. Connection
The network device (IP camera, wireless AP, VoIP phone, Ethernet switch etc) with RJ-45 interface is connected to RJ-45 jack of media converter through twisted-pair. And the multi/single mode optical fiber is connected to SC/ST/FC/LC fiber interface of the optical transceiver module. Then connect the AC power adaptor, the media converter will work. The corresponding LED is on for correct connection (See table below for relative LED indicator lamp explanation).
Description for LED indicator lamp
LED indicator lamps serve as device monitoring and trouble display. The following are the description for each LED indicator lamp.
Fast Ethernet media converter
1	On: Transfer rate of fiber interface is 100Mbps.
2	On: Transfer rate of electric interface is 100Mbps.
3	On: Optic fiber cable is connected well, but no data transmission
3	Blinking: receiving data
4	On: Twisted pair is connected well, but no data transmission
4	Blinking: receiving data
5	ON: Half duplex mode
6	ON: The power is working
Gigabit Ethernet media converter
1	On: Transfer rate of electric interface is 1000Mbps.
2	On: Transfer rate of electric interface is 100Mbps.
3	On: Optic fiber cable is connected well, but no data transmission
3	Blinking: receiving data
4	On: Twisted pair is connected well, but no data transmission
4	Blinking: receiving data
5	ON: Full duplex mode
6	ON: The power is working
Mini size gigabit media converter
Green indicator Link/act	Indicator on: electrical port link
Green indicator Link/act	Indicator off: electrical port not link
Green indicator Link/act	Indicator blinking: electrical port link and receive data
Yellow indicator  Speed	Indicator on: 1000M speed  link
Yellow indicator  Speed	Indicator off: 10/100M  speed link
10G media converter
1	On: Power is on and normal
2	On: Fiber link is in correct connection.
2	Blink: Fiber link is receiving data
3	On: Fiber signal is detected
4	On: Transfer rate of electric interface is 10Gbps
4	Off: Transfer rate of electric interface is 10/100/1000Mbps
5	ON: Electric link is in correct state
6	Blink: Electric link is receiving data
Description for Dip switch(some enhanced function models of Fast and Gigabit Ethernet media converters support these function)
Fast Ethernet media converter
Dip 1 ON to enable LFP , OFF is disable LFP
Dip 2 ON to enable network storm suppression
Dip 3 ON to fix the electrical port on 10M
Dip 4 ON to make the electrical port on half duplex; off to make the electrical port on full duplex
Gigabit Ethernet media converter
Dip 1 ON to enable LFP , OFF is disable LFP
Dip 2 ON to enable network storm suppression
Dip 3 ON to fix the fiber port on 100M
Dip 4 ON to fix the electrical port on 100M
Main Features
1. Comply with IEEE 802.3 10Base-T, IEEE 802.3u 100Base-TX, IEEE 802.3ab 1000Base-T, IEEE 802.3z 1000Base-SX, IEEE 802.3bz 2.5G/5GBASE-T, IEEE 802.3an 10GBASE-T, IEEE 802.3ae 10Gbps Ethernet,
2. Support IEEE802.3x flow control.
3. Support auto MDI/MDI-X function.
4. Support watchdog function
5. In conformity to certification of FCC ,CE and RoHS
Technical Parameters
1. Standard Protocol:
Comply with IEEE 802.3 10Base-T, IEEE 802.3u 100Base-TX, IEEE 802.3ab 1000Base-T, IEEE 802.3z 1000Base-SX, IEEE 802.3bz 2.5G/5GBASE-T, IEEE 802.3an 10GBASE-T, IEEE 802.3ae 10Gbps Ethernet.
2. Connector: One UTP RJ-45 connector, one SC/ST/FC/LC connector, one DC-inlet connector
3. Operation mode: Full duplex or half duplex mode
4. Power Supply: DC 5-12V
5. Environmental Temperature: 0℃-50 ℃
6. Relative Humidity: 5%-90%
7. TP Cable: Cat5e or CAT6 UTP cable
8. Optical Fiber:
Multi-mode:
50/125, 62.5/125 or 100/140μm
Single mode:
8.3/125, 8.7/125, 9/125 or 10/125μm
9. Dimensions: 94(L) x 71 (W) x 27 (H)mm
(Do not include transceiver length)
Cautions
1. This product is suitable for indoor application.
2. Put on dust cover of fiber interface when not use.
3. It is forbidden to stare at the TX fiber-transfer end
with naked eyes.
4.Single optical fiber transceiver must be used in pair.
Media converter normal trouble shooting Q & A
1. Q: Power indicator is not on ?
A: Please check whether turn on the power supply or the power adaptor is broken
2. Q: Fiber link is not working ?
A: (1). Please check whether the fiber link is broken
(2). Please check whether the fiber link loss is beyond the receiving range of the media converter
(3). Please check if the fiber optical interface was connected correctly? The right connection way is the local TX connects with remote side RX. The remote side TX connects with the local RX
(4). Please check whether the fiber connector is inserted in the media converter interface well and the fiber patch cord is matched with the media converter interface. And also the transmission distance is matched with the media converter
3. Q: Electrical interface link is not working ?
A: (1). Please check whether the RJ45 cable is broken.
(2). Please check whether you use the correct cable: use the cross-wire cable to connect with networking card and router. Use the direct line cable to connect with the switch and Hub
(3). Please check whether the equipment transmission rate is matched
4. Q: Serious network packet loss ?
A: (1). The mismatch of the duplex mode between the MC and other connected equipment, like switch, router
(2). Please check whether there are some problem with RJ45 cable and the RJ45 plug
(3). Please check whether you use the correct patch cord and make the correct connection
(4). Please check whether the fiber link loss is beyond the receive sensitivity
5. Q: It can not communicate after media converter is connected ？
A: (1). The fiber connection are opposite, please exchange all the TX and RX fiber
(2). The RJ45 port is not correctly connected with other equipments (please pay attention to the cross line and direct line) The fiber port may also have the mismatch problem, for example: if the media converter is with LFP function, when you connect the fiber patch cord with APC core to the media converter which the transceiver is with PC core, the media converter will not communicate. But if the media converter is without LFP function, there will be no effect
6. Q: Which kinds of testing method of media converter if the media converter has problem?
A: (1). Local site test: Connect the two MCs with two PC and do the Ping test. If Ping is no problem, that’s to say, media converters have no problem; if it is Ping problem and can make sure the media converter has problem
(2). Remote site test: Connect the two media converters with two PC and do the Ping test. If Ping is not ok, you have to check whether the fiber link is normal and the transmission & receiving power of PC are within the proper range; If It is no problem with Ping test, which will show the fiber link is ok and you can judge there are some problem with the switches
